payload.title: Document the Medium filter on p.apyr.us (follow-up of PPY-ec0d0a)
payload.description: Document the References page Medium row (All, Videos) on the Papyrus product site p.apyr.us: the buttons beside Reviewed, pending videos in two clicks, the link that opens it (medium=video), that it reads the medium index without scanning, that Predictions cannot order a medium, and that References whose medium is unknown are listed under All only. Source: docs/reference-feed-indexes.md, The medium filter. Standing task from PPY-ec0d0a; publish through the Papyrus-web content flow, then close.
